summary: +2 to attack and damage rolls; as you attack it can become any Simple Melee weapon until your next turn.
text: You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon. When you take the Attack action you can turn it into any Simple Melee weapon until the start of your next turn. Choose Strength or Dexterity for its attack and damage rolls in any shape (the game uses the better).
